race.comment: MANUSCRIPT (8) resumes as the horse to beat off a long break, with his last-campaign Canterbury profile reading well for this. He won a BM64 by just under a length after leading and giving a strong kick, had earlier placed in the same grade, and a Townsville trial win gives him a sound platform to return from. SUPER FREEZE (13) brings the strongest recent local 1000m line, beaten a neck in a Class 5 at this track on soft ground after being bumped and making contact near the 200m. His track-and-distance record is a major asset. HARTSHORN (1) comes off an Open win at this venue where he beat Lucky Rolla by two and a half lengths, and his three wins from seven track-and-distance attempts make him a genuine winning danger. CIFONELLI (5) resumes after competitive Open form at this venue last preparation and a solid second in a Townsville trial, so he has the right profile to run well fresh.
